title: The children's hospital has asked for a visit
text: A group of players, an afternoon, a lot of jumpers to sign.

choices.label: Send a group
choices.note: It costs you an afternoon's training.
choices.result: The players spend the afternoon on the wards.

choices.label: Training comes first
choices.result: You keep the players on the track.

stakes: Sending a group costs you an afternoon's training.

title: A country club wants {name} for a junior clinic
text: It's a three-hour drive on his day off.

choices.label: Send {first}
choices.result: {name} runs the clinic. The kids won't forget it.

choices.label: Not this week
choices.result: The clinic will have to wait.

title: The Foundation wants players at a fundraiser
text: A Thursday night dinner, the night before the side flies out.

choices.label: Make it compulsory
choices.result: The whole list is in suits on Thursday night.

title: {name}'s junior club has burnt down
text: The rooms at the club he grew up at went up overnight. He wants to help.

choices.label: Let {first} go back on Sunday

effects.why: You let him help his old club after the fire

choices.result: {name} spends Sunday with his old club.

choices.label: Send a signed jumper instead
choices.result: The club sends a signed jumper.

title: A school has asked for {name}
text: His old school wants him at assembly on Friday.

effects.why: You kept game weeks on football

title: The club's greats want to drop in before the final
text: A few champions from the club's past would like ten minutes with the players at Thursday's session.

choices.label: Bring them in
choices.result: In the huddle with players whose names are on the honour boards. The young ones hang off every word.

choices.label: Not this week

effects.why: You kept finals week on the football

choices.result: The session runs as planned. A couple of the old players take it personally, and the board hears about it.

title: The night before
text: {forecast_line} Some of them won't sleep a wink.

choices.label: Keep the players together

effects.why: The players spent the night before the Grand Final together

choices.result: One long table, a few quiet words from the captain, lights out by ten.

choices.label: Send them home to their families
choices.result: Dinner at home and their own bed. A few have a full house and a late night.
